description: Search sealed catalog identity and available offer records by a third-party listing's name, set and product type. catalogMatches covers boxes, packs and cases, returning exact product IDs, kind, physicalLanguage, form, contentsState, intact marketPrice with marketPriceObservedAt, coverage (priceState, modelState, evState, totalEv, missingInput), and a cached pokemonEvDisplay when available. A Pokemon tier partial gives a numeric priced-component value with valueScope and missingFields; it may include an exact identified promo. It is not full product EV or a lower bound and must not be ranked as one. Its marginal rate sensitivity is not an opening percentile or joint confidence interval. A zero-observation rare-tail gross bound, when present, uses the stated maximum copies per pack, representative independent packs and frozen subtype prices; it ignores displaced card value and is not added to the central partial value. products returns deal rows with modeled totalEV and offer evidence when supported. Call spellbook_sealed_product_offers with a deal row's tcgProductId for retail references, available sold comparables and freshness. This tool carries no per-pack distribution; for how many packs until opening is likely profitable, how swingy a box is, or what share of packs beat the pack price, call spellbook_box_ev_rankings with q set to the product name. The backend chooses the public or entitled response. A public response sets teaser true and returns fewer deal rows. Each TCGplayer product id carries tcgplayerBuyUrl, a short SpellBook Finance affiliate link to that TCGplayer page. Say it is an affiliate link when you share it.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

game.description: Restrict results to one game: mtg, riftbound or pokemon. Omit for a mixed-game search.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 100. Omit for the default of 20.

productType.description: Exact sealed product type to filter to. Omit to include every type.

q.description: Free-text product name search. Omit to browse without a name filter.

region.description: Restrict results to one currency region: US, CA, NZ or All. Omit for all.

store.description: Exact store name to filter to. Omit to include every store.

name: spellbook_sealed_product_search
